suggested_experiment_name: Irreducible Axion Background (freeze-in relic, T_RH=5 MeV, photophilic)
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis
notes: Cosmological/astrophysical constraint derived by recasting DM-decay searches (X-ray, CRB, CMB) onto an irreducible freeze-in axion relic. Paper presents TWO main results: photophilic axion g_agamma (Fig.1) and photophobic axion g_aee (Fig.2). I extracted the photophilic (AxionPhoton) branch per the hint. Only explicit numerical text value available: at m_a=10 keV, g_agamma <= 8.1e-14 GeV^-1. The full exclusion curve spans 100 eV - 100 MeV but numerical curve points are only in figures (not machine-readable here). Note the companion photophobic bound is g_aee <= 8.0e-15 at 100 keV (AxionElectron). Not a haloscope, so no local DM density.
